title: Give Night a quieter focus
summary: Night now puts assignment, handover and the selected roster night ahead of surrounding chrome, with a calmer personal hero, a contextual compact header and lighter floating controls.
changes: Night now opens with a leaner hospital header, one clear page title and a lighter date navigator, removing repeated labels while keeping the selected roster night obvious.
Your assignment hero is calmer and more compact while preserving the live handover rail, colleague, duty and break information, clock-change guidance and every existing roster calculation.
As Night scrolls, the hospital masthead now morphs into a compact glass header carrying your assignment and selected date instead of leaving an empty collapsed header.
The update prompt and bottom navigation are smaller, clearer and more genuinely translucent, with quieter secondary actions, a refined active state and reduced-transparency fallbacks.
During the active working night, the interface subtly increases emphasis on the assignment and handover instrument without changing staffing, allocation, break or PWA update behaviour.
